dependency_versions.sentencepiece: not installed; local tokenizer.json avoids conversion

environment.initialization: eager shared embedding and NLI; excluded from attempt timer

design.execution: sequential CPU; existing caches; factory initialization outside timer
design.failure_behavior: First raised exception stops existing cost collector after preserving measured partial rows; later attempts are absent; missing required verifiers block calibration
design.freeze_procedure: Approve design and outcome-free exclusion roster before collection; record immutable input/setup/request digests after collection and before calibration; retain all measured failures and all scheduled first calls; never inspect final outcomes
design.metadata_scope: two tags/version pairs in factory; no per-attempt live observer
design.population: Convenience sample: 80 reference-assisted constructed arithmetic plus six short factual preparation examples; not representative project-wide
design.retained: MeasurementInput, attempt statuses, monotonic durations, factory-observed setup and input identities; no returned report payloads
design.scientific_scope: Cost estimation only. No correctness adjudication, policy fitting, final evaluation or publication claims
